subject: Re: Staggered demo + validated ingest slot request for FinLytics
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finlytics.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: ops@finlytics.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Shift request: FinLytics showcase — validated ingest slot needed

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Quick note — our exec team just changed travel plans and the VP who needs to join the walkthrough will now be on-site Nov 30–Dec 1. We still want to run the product showcase, but we need to restructure the session so we can do an engineer-facing dry run + ingest validation before the exec walkthrough.

Can Redwood support a staggered approach:
- A validated ingest slot (sample data run + access verification) the business week before the exec walkthrough so our data team can confirm results against our golden dataset.
- A tech dry run with Redwood engineering (internal-only) to iron out prompt sets and KV cache behavior.
- Exec-facing demo later (same day or next day) for the leadership walkthrough.

Constraints:
- Prefer ingest validation the week of Nov 29 — afternoons PT are best for our engineers.
- Exec walkthrough must be between Nov 30 and Dec 2, ideally mornings PT.
- We will need SSO test accounts and a temporary token for ingestion (no PII in the test set).

Attaching the sample schema and our (partial) travel itinerary so you can see timing. Please let us know available windows and any runbook/checklist we should follow for access.

Attachments: finlytics_sample_schema.csv (csv) | travel_itinerary.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Alex Chen
VP Product, FinLytics
alex.chen@finlytics.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0191

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finlytics.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shift request: FinLytics showcase — validated ingest slot needed

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the constraints, I appreciate the detail. We can absolutely run a staggered flow; proposed plan below (open to tweaks):

Proposed schedule (PT):
- Nov 29, 15:00–16:00 — Ingest validation slot (we’ll run a trimmed pipeline on your sample payload and validate token rotation).
- Nov 30, 10:00–11:30 — Engineering dry run (prompt set exercise + workload traces, internal attendees only).
- Dec 1, 11:00–11:45 — Exec walkthrough (short, focused; fallback plan if latency/variance appears).

What we’ll need from you before the ingest slot:
- Golden dataset manifest (file list + key fields) — attach as JSON or CSV.
- SSO test user(s) + one service token with restricted scope for ingestion.
- List of priority prompts/workload traces (1–3) you want exercised during the dry run.

I’m attaching a short runbook (redwood_runbook_staggered.md) and an access-checklist so your ops team can provision accounts ahead of Nov 29. We’ll provision a temporary test workspace and rotate tokens after validation. If any of the proposed times don’t work, suggest alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Runbook link: https://drive.redwood.com/finlytics/demo-runbook-staggered
Attachments: redwood_runbook_staggered.md | access-checklist.txt

I’ll loop in Marissa to confirm SSO timelines and any pre-demo data transforms.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shift request: FinLytics showcase — validated ingest slot needed

Looping in a couple quick ops notes:

- Nov 29 at 3pm PT for ingest validation works for our infra team but we need SSO accounts created by EOD Nov 27 to hit that window (AD/SCIM provisioning lead time).
- For the dry run we’ll focus on 2 prompt sets: 
  * Prioritize: lead-scoring prompts (high token churn)
  * Secondary: classification prompts (shorter context)
- Can we move the exec walkthrough to Dec 2, 11:00–11:30 PT? I have a calendar collision on Dec 1 with another customer commitment. If Dec 2 is a hard blocker for your execs we can keep Dec 1 and move the dry run earlier the same day.

Alex — could you attach the golden_dataset_manifest.json (just filenames & record counts) and confirm which fields are redacted? Also confirm ops@finlytics will create the SSO test users (we need the provisioning ticket).

Attachments: golden_dataset_manifest.json (snippet)

Thanks — I’ll stand up the ingest job template and send a shareable dashboard for throughput/latency during the run.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@finlytics.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shift request: FinLytics showcase — validated ingest slot needed

Thanks — Dec 2, 11:00–11:30 PT for the exec walkthrough is fine; we’ll take that. ops@finlytics will create SSO test users and send the provisioning ticket by tomorrow EOD. I’ve attached the golden_dataset_manifest.json snippet and confirmed fields are redacted per our data policy.

Confirmed schedule (PT):
- Nov 29, 15:00–16:00 — Ingest validation (Redwood runbook + access checklist)
- Nov 30, 10:00–11:30 — Engineering dry run (internal)
- Dec 2, 11:00–11:30 — Exec walkthrough

Attachments: golden_dataset_manifest.json (snippet)

Appreciate the flexibility — we’ll share the provisioning ticket and test tokens once ops confirms. If you need anything from our data team (sample transforms, record hashes), ping ops@finlytics.com.

Best,
Alex
VP Product, FinLytics
